description: Defines the HttpAuthController class, which manages HTTP authentication processes, including handling challenges, credentials, and authentication schemes for a specific target (proxy or server). It includes methods for generating auth tokens, adding headers, handling challenges, and managing auth state.

classes.name: HttpAuthController
classes.description: Main class managing HTTP authentication, handling challenges, credentials, and scheme-specific logic for a single target (proxy or server).

methods.name: HttpAuthController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller with target, URL, cache, handler factory, and resolver.

methods.name: MaybeGenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates an auth token if needed, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: AddAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Adds the appropriate Authorization header based on current auth state.

methods.name: HandleAuthChallenge
methods.description: Processes 401/407 responses to handle auth challenges.

methods.name: ResetAuth
methods.description: Stores new credentials and resets auth state.

methods.name: HaveAuthHandler
methods.description: Checks if an auth handler is present.

methods.name: NeedsHTTP11
methods.description: Indicates if the current scheme requires HTTP/1.1.

methods.name: TakeAuthInfo
methods.description: Swaps auth challenge info into provided variable.

methods.name: IsAuthSchemeDisabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific auth scheme is disabled.
